title: Putting Off and Putting On
definition: Putting Off and Putting On is the biblical pattern of rejecting sinful ways and embracing new conduct fitting for life in Christ.
summary: Discipleship involves turning from old patterns and walking in new life.
christFocus: Jesus Christ has made believers new, so they are called to put off the old self and put on Christlike character.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Putting Off and Putting On describes a Spirit-formed pattern of life for those who belong to Jesus Christ. Christian living is not an attempt to earn salvation but the grateful response of people who have been saved by grace and called to walk with the Lord.

Scripture presents this truth so believers can grow in holiness, endurance, love, wisdom, worship, and mission. It touches the heart, the mind, the tongue, relationships, daily habits, and faithful obedience in ordinary life.

The emphasis of this doctrine is discipleship involves turning from old patterns and walking in new life.. It points disciples away from self-reliance and toward abiding dependence on Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because discipleship can become shallow when it is reduced to information, emotion, or outward activity alone. Putting Off and Putting On teaches believers how grace becomes visible in daily conduct, perseverance, relationships, and obedience to Christ.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask the Lord to form this truth in you through Scripture, prayer, repentance, and faithful practice. Let putting off and putting on shape how you think, speak, serve, endure, forgive, and represent Christ in the places God has assigned to you.
